title: Faltering Will
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to gain disadvantage on Wisdom checks until Long Rest.

fields.Inspiration: Drinking grants An Acquired Taste to Guild Artisan party members.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Gain disadvantage on Wisdom ability checks until Long Rest. The tooltip says saves, but the pinned condition reports ability checks.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
